nodes.text: Does there exist a maximal Sidon set $A\subset \{1,\ldots,N\}$ of size $O(N^{1/3})$?

#156 : [ESS94] sidon sets A question of Erdős, Sárközy, and Sós [ESS94] . It is easy to prove that the greedy construction of a maximal Sidon set in $\{1,\ldots,N\}$ has size $\gg N^{1/3}$. Ruzsa [Ru98b] constructed a maximal Sidon set of size $\ll (N\log N)^{1/3}$. See also [340] .
